The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to express FRET biosensors in transgenic mice using a cell type specific promoter.
we can now express biosynthetic Ca(2+) sensor proteins in transgenic mice, and that these sensors can be used for in vivo optical imaging.
we can use genetically encoded fluorescent indicators to image calcium in transgenic mice and that the indicators can be targeted to specific cell types.
